ALTER VIEW [DW].[FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment_View]
	AS 

WITH FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment_Latest AS (
SELECT
max(FDL.BusinessDateSK) AS BusinessDateSK
FROM DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment as FDL
)

Select TRY.*
from DW.FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment as TRY
    INNER JOIN FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment_Latest as FDL
        ON FDL.BusinessDateSK = TRY.BusinessDateSK
